lead: Offshore the decisions are yours: which turn, which door to shut, when to leave the yacht, whom to call on which band. Command also brings duties in law.

fig.title: Scharnow turn from 130°T
lines: Wheel hard to starboard
Reverse it at 130° + 240° = 010°T
Steady on the reciprocal: 310°T
Search back along your own wake

fig.note: High freeboard: stop upwind, beam-on, drift onto him

lines: Stop engines, generator, fans; shut flaps
Count everyone out, then release

fig.title: How long have you got?
lines: In 650 L/min, pumps 250 L/min: net 400
Lost with 6,000 L more aboard
Distress alert and rafts now

fig.title: Range under power
lines: Fuel 90 L, keep 20%: 72 L usable
4.5 L/h at 6 kn: 16 h
Port 120 M off: a jury rig as well
No spare belt, 30 h to go
Lights and VHF stay on; plot on paper

fig.title: Cold water: 1-10-1
lines: 1 minute: cold shock, control your breathing
10 minutes of useful movement: swim now
1 hour before hypothermia: then keep still
Alone: HELP, knees up, arms crossed, still
Together: huddle, chests touching

fig.note: Wind 040°T, 30° on the port bow: steer 070°T
Sea areas follow the coast stations' DSC cover

fig.title: In the grab bag
lines: EPIRB: registered to you with the flag state
False alert: switch off, tell the MRCC
Radar SART: flashes when a radar sweeps it
AIS-SART: shows with position on AIS screens
NAVTEX: nav, gale, SAR messages always print

fig.title: Silence on channel 16
lines: SEELONCE MAYDAY: casualty or control station
SEELONCE DISTRESS: any other station nearby
PRUDONCE: restricted working may resume
SEELONCE FEENEE: distress traffic ended

fig.title: Correcting the log
lines: 0300 · Course 245°T: one line through it
254°T written beside it, initialled
The old figure stays readable
Never erase or tear out a page

fig.title: Before the passage: the policy
lines: Limits: area, season; extension in writing
Warranties: skipper's certificate, use, crew
Private pleasure: no paying guests
Hull covers your yacht; third party, others
Disclosure: every material fact, or void

fig.note: From arrival until you are cleared

fig.title: Salvage Convention 1989
lines: No cure, no pay: no result, no reward (LOF)
The award never exceeds the value saved
No danger: towage price; refusal bars a claim
Beyond the contract: salvage for extra work
The master signs; life salvors get a share
